item.text: {"findings":[{"severity":"major","cites":["A-0003","A-0005","C-0018"],"kind":"finding","klass":"actionable","argument":"The algorithm preserves existing hyphens in step `A-0003` and then blindly joins the resulting tokens with hyphens in `A-0005`. For an input like `a - b`, the preserved hyphen plus the join separators produce `a---b`, which violates `C-0018`'s no-consecutive-hyphens invariant. The contract needs an explicit rule for collapsing or normalizing pre-existing hyphens before joining."}],"verdict":"REVISE"}
